name: Mean temperature
description: Average daily temperature over the year.
definition: Annual mean of daily mean 2 m air temperature.

name: Mean daily maximum temperature
description: Average of the daily high temperatures over the year.
definition: Annual mean of daily maximum 2 m air temperature.

name: Mean daily minimum temperature
description: Average of the daily low temperatures over the year.
definition: Annual mean of daily minimum 2 m air temperature.

name: Coldest night
description: Lowest daily minimum temperature reached during the year.
definition: Annual minimum of daily minimum 2 m air temperature.

name: Hottest day
description: Highest daily maximum temperature reached during the year.
definition: Annual maximum of daily maximum 2 m air temperature.

name: Days above 20°C
description: Number of days each year when the daily high is above 20°C.
definition: Count of days with daily maximum 2 m air temperature > 20°C.

name: Days above 25°C
description: Number of days each year when the daily high is above 25°C.
definition: Count of days with daily maximum 2 m air temperature > 25°C.

name: Days above 30°C
description: Number of days each year when the daily high is above 30°C.
definition: Count of days with daily maximum 2 m air temperature > 30°C.

name: Nights above 10°C
description: Number of days each year when the daily low stays above 10°C.
definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature > 10°C.

name: Nights above 15°C
description: Number of days each year when the daily low stays above 15°C.
definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature > 15°C.

name: Nights below -20°C
description: Number of nights each year when the minimum temperature falls below -20°C.
definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature < -20°C.

name: Nights below -30°C
description: Number of nights each year when the minimum temperature falls below -30°C.
definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature < -30°C.

name: Nights below -40°C
description: Number of nights each year when the minimum temperature falls below -40°C.
definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature < -40°C.

name: Frost days
description: Number of days each year with a minimum temperature below freezing.
definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature < 0°C.

name: Ice days
description: Number of days each year when the temperature stays below freezing all day.
definition: Count of days with daily maximum 2 m air temperature < 0°C.

name: Freeze-thaw days
description: Number of days each year when temperatures fall below freezing and rise above freezing on the same day.
definition: Count of days with daily minimum temperature < 0°C and daily maximum temperature > 0°C.

name: Frost-free season length
description: Number of days between the last spring frost and the first fall frost.
definition: Number of days between the last day with daily minimum temperature < 0°C before July 15 and the first day with daily minimum temperature < 0°C on or after July 15.

name: Growing degree days above 0°C
description: Accumulated warmth above 0°C over the year.
definition: Annual sum of max(daily mean temperature - 0°C, 0), in °C·days.

name: Growing degree days above 5°C
description: Accumulated warmth above 5°C over the year.
definition: Annual sum of max(daily mean temperature - 5°C, 0), in °C·days.

name: Heating degree days below 18°C
description: Accumulated cold relative to 18°C, an indicator of heating demand.
definition: Annual sum of max(18°C - daily mean temperature, 0), in °C·days.

name: Cooling degree days above 18°C
description: Accumulated warmth relative to 18°C, an indicator of cooling demand.
definition: Annual sum of max(daily mean temperature - 18°C, 0), in °C·days.

name: Total precipitation
description: Total rain and snowfall water equivalent received over the year.
definition: Annual sum of daily total precipitation, expressed as liquid-water equivalent in millimetres.

name: Wet days
description: Number of days each year with at least 1 mm of precipitation.
definition: Count of days with total precipitation ≥ 1 mm.

name: Heavy precipitation days
description: Number of days each year with at least 10 mm of precipitation.
definition: Count of days with total precipitation ≥ 10 mm.

name: Very heavy precipitation days
description: Number of days each year with at least 20 mm of precipitation.
definition: Count of days with total precipitation ≥ 20 mm.

name: Maximum 1-day precipitation
description: Largest precipitation total in any single day of the year.
definition: Maximum daily precipitation total within each year.

name: Maximum 5-day precipitation
description: Largest precipitation total over any consecutive 5-day period.
definition: Maximum rolling 5-day precipitation total within each year.

name: Longest dry spell
description: Longest run of consecutive days each year with less than 1 mm of precipitation.
definition: Maximum number of consecutive days with total precipitation < 1 mm.

name: Fraction of precipitation falling as snow
description: Percentage of annual precipitation that fell as snow.
definition: 100 × annual snowfall water equivalent / annual total precipitation, bounded from 0% to 100%.

name: Total rainfall and fraction of precipitation falling as snow
source: ERA5-Land daily SWE/snowfall/snowpack variables; Yukon snow-course and station observations; satellite snow cover recommended for validation

name: Rain-on-snow and midwinter melt events
source: Water Survey of Canada HYDAT/hydrometric gauges; ERA5-Land runoff only as supporting context; local flood/ice-jam records where available

name: Persistent snow onset, disappearance and season length
source: ERA5-Land daily SWE/snowfall/snowpack variables; Yukon snow-course and station observations; satellite snow cover recommended for validation

name: Total snowfall water equivalent, snowfall days and heavy snowfall days
source: ERA5-Land daily SWE/snowfall/snowpack variables; Yukon snow-course and station observations; satellite snow cover recommended for validation

name: Estimated snow depth and mean snow density
source: ERA5-Land SWE/snow density-derived depth; Yukon snow-course observations recommended for validation

name: Mean and maximum SWE; days with snowpack
source: ERA5-Land daily SWE/snowfall/snowpack variables; Yukon snow-course and station observations; satellite snow cover recommended for validation

name: Annual and cumulative glacier mass change
source: WGMS annual mass-change estimates (AMCE); gridded glacier-change product used as consistency check

name: Root-zone and surface soil-moisture anomalies
source: ERA5-Land soil moisture; independent satellite/observational product recommended for validation

name: Climatic water balance (precipitation minus PET)
source: ERA5-Land daily precipitation/snowfall; ECCC/AHCCD gauges for validation; CanGRD where appropriate for broad historical comparison

name: Potential evapotranspiration
source: ERA5-Land precipitation/PET for spatial context; ECCC/AHCCD station precipitation for validation; SPI/SPEI derived from validated inputs

name: Cloud cover and sunshine duration
source: ERA5 total cloud cover; ERA5 surface solar radiation for sunshine/radiation context

name: Total cloud cover by Yukon community, annual and seasonal
source: ERA5 single-level total_cloud_cover, 1940-present; Yukon community locations

name: Shortwave, longwave, net radiation and albedo
source: ERA5-Land surface radiation and albedo variables; satellite products recommended for validation

name: Relative humidity, vapour-pressure deficit and drying power
source: ERA5/ERA5-Land temperature and dew point/humidity; station observations for validation; radiation/wind needed for UTCI/WBGT

name: Mean and extreme wind speed, gusts and blizzard conditions
source: ERA5/ERA5-Land near-surface wind components; ECCC station wind observations for validation

name: AO, PDO, ONI/Niño3.4, NP, NAO, SOI, AMO, PNA and EP-NP
source: NOAA/CPC and related published climate-index time series; Yukon seasonal temperature series from ERA5-Land

name: ENSO impacts and event magnitude (ONI/RONI) on Yukon temperature/precipitation/snowfall
source: NOAA ONI/RONI indices; Yukon historical climate fields from project datasets

name: Total area burned
description: Area of Yukon mapped as burned by wildfire each year.
definition: Annual total area within Yukon recorded as burned by wildfire.

name: Number of fires
description: Number of mapped wildfires recorded in Yukon each year.
definition: Annual count of wildfire records in the Yukon fire-history dataset.

name: Fire severity
source: Government of Yukon Wildland Fire Management station archive
description: Summer Daily Severity Rating across the established eight-community series.
definition: June-August Daily Severity Rating, a severity-weighted measure derived from Fire Weather Index.

name: Fire Weather Index
source: Government of Yukon Wildland Fire Management station archive
description: Severity of sustained fire-weather conditions during the fire season.
definition: Annual maximum 90-day running mean Fire Weather Index across the fixed long-record station panel.
